objective: Bring 4 Durotar Tiger Furs to Vel'rin Fang in Sen'jin Village.

description: Many of the hides we use come from Durotar tigers, <name>. Blankets, armor, tents: there are a great many reasons we hunt the beasts, and many reasons we let them thrive at the same time.
The time has come for us to cull the flock, so to speak. Our numbers grow, and our needs are beginning to overwhelm our stocks. I need more hides if I'm to prepare suitable goods for our people.
Bring me 4 Durotar tiger furs, and I shall reward you. You can find them on the islands south of here.
progress: I remember my first tiger hunt, <name>. I chose to hunt on the largest of the Echo Isles, and I sat perfectly still in the shadows of its foliage for almost a full day... watching... waiting.
My muscles were taut, and I was ready to strike. It was one of my greatest victories when that tiger finally took the bait.
completion: I am pleased, <name>. Because of your help, our people will be protected, and not go cold as the seasons change.
